sentences.en: My nonprofit has a hands on approach to problem solving.
sentences.zh: 我们的非营利组织采用亲力亲为的方法来解决问题。

sentences.en: She volunteers at a local nonprofit that helps homeless people.
sentences.zh: 她在一家帮助无家可归者的当地非营利机构做志愿者。

sentences.en: The nonprofit organization is trying to raise funds for its programs.
sentences.zh: 这家非营利组织正在为其项目筹集资金。
